cfs.buckets.Definition

Describes the parameters to retrieve the buckets from a client file store with all their attributes.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.cfs.buckets.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    name: str | None = None,
    created_since: str | None = None,
    modified_since: str | None = None,
    available_from: str | None = None,
    available_to: str | None = None,
    attributes: OptStrStrs = None,
    page_size: int = 25,
    skip_token: str | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
name str | None No None Bucket name for partial match searching.
created_since str | None No None Bucket creation date.
modified_since str | None No None Bucket modification date.
available_from str | None No None Bucket availability start date.
available_to str | None No None Bucket availability end date.
attributes OptStrStrs No None Publisher-defined bucket attributes.
page_size int No 25 Number of buckets returned.
skip_token str | None No None Skip token is only used if a previous operation returned a partial result. If a previous response contains a nextLink element, the value of the nextLink element will include a skip token parameter that specifies a starting point to use for subsequent calls.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the client file store to retrieve the previously defined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

TypeData instance.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the previously defined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None User-defined callback function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response

Returns

TypeData instance

Example

from lseg.data.delivery import cfs
definition = cfs.buckets.Definition()
buckets = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
